title: OpenArc configuration
description: Settings for OpenArc, read from openarc.config.json. OpenArc looks for the file in the directory it builds and then in each parent directory, and uses the first one it finds. Every setting is optional.

theme.description: Colour theme for the viewer. "system" follows the reader's operating system setting; any other value is the name of a theme in design/themes/, such as "light" or "dark".

layoutEngine.description: When the diagram is laid out. "build" lays it out when the page is built, so the page carries the layout and not the engine: it opens fastest and stays small. "inline" and "cdn" lay it out each time the page opens, with ELK embedded in the page (about 1.6 MB more, 470 kB compressed) or loaded from jsDelivr.
